subject: CSA questionnaire: control narrative & evidence escort for Cedarline onboarding
messages:
From: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@cedarline.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: security@cedarline.com
Date: 2026-08-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ mapping & evidence ask for Cedarline onboarding

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As discussed, Cedarline is working through the CSA/CAIQ questionnaire for our vendor intake. Please find the PDF attached with the specific controls we flagged as in-scope and a couple of clarifying notes.

High-level asks:
- Control mapping (CAIQ) on our specified subset: CCM v4 controls: ID: TM-01, CR-02, IAM-05, LOG-09.
- Sample evidence for runtime logs (last 30 days), KMS rotation proof, and network segmentation diagram.
- A short control narrative for the tenant isolation and data residency controls that we can include in our intake packet.

Timing: Cedarline would like an initial response and draft artifacts by EOD Friday (2026-08-28) to meet our procurement window. If certain items need additional approvals (e.g., SOC2 report or legal redlines), flag those and we can carve out extra time.

Attachments: Cedarline_CSA_Request_20260826.pdf (control subset and notes).

If helpful, happy to do a 30-minute walkthrough next week to review the evidence set.

Thanks,
Sarah Linton
Security & Risk Lead | Cedarline Health
(sarah.linton@cedarline.com)

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@cedarline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence ask for Cedarline onboarding

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask and the PDF. We're on it. Quick plan below:

1) Draft CAIQ mapping: we will map the listed CCM controls to our CAIQ responses and attach the control narrative for tenant isolation and data residency (owner: Kimberly).
2) Evidence harvest: Marcus will pull the runtime logs and prepare a redacted 30-day sample (.zip). We will include log retention policy text and an extract script so your auditors can reproduce the sample.
3) KMS rotation docs: we'll provide the rotation schedule and KMS attestation excerpt (may need legal approval for some details).

Proposed timeline: initial draft + artifact links by 2026-08-28 COB. If any items require longer, we'll call them out by EOD tomorrow.

Action items for internal owners (cc'd):
- @kimberly_park: prepare tenant isolation narrative and control mapping sheet.
- @marcus_lin: collect runtime logs (redacted), network segmentation diagram, and list of artifact locations.

Related records: HubSpot deal CED-2026-0826 (link below) — I will attach the CAIQ draft there and share Drive folder access for Cedarline reviewers.

Sarah, can you confirm the preferred delivery method for artifacts? (Drive link vs. secure ShareFile vs. DocuSign room for attestations).

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_csa_response_draft_v1.xlsx (mapping template)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, Sarah Linton <sarah.linton@cedarline.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-26T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence ask for Cedarline onboarding

Thanks Rachel / Sarah —

I’ll take the tenant isolation and data residency narratives. Draft plan:
- Short narrative (1-2 paragraphs) describing how Redwood isolates tenant workloads across Dedicated and Private deployments, and the controls we enforce (network ACLs, VPC peering restrictions, and hypervisor-level separation).
- Include references to our deployment diagrams and the tenancy ownership matrix.
- Call out where customers can opt for Private (VPC/on-prem) vs. hosted and what that changes in evidence.

Marcus — I’ll need the network segmentation diagram and the runtime log sample to cite specifics (log filename pattern, sampling window).

Sarah — for sensitive items (full SOC2 report or KMS key material), Legal usually requires a NDAsigned DocuSign; is that something Cedarline already has in place for this procurement? If not, we can route the SOC2 summary and redacted snippets today and put the full artifacts behind ShareFile pending signed NDA.

I’ll populate the mapping sheet and send Version 1 by EOD tomorrow.

Kimberly Park
Director, Risk & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Morning everyone —

Quick status update:
- Collected log extracts: runtime_log_sample_202607.zip (redacted) — contains 30 days of API gateway logs, request IDs, and tenant tags. Will upload to the Drive folder and share a time-limited link.
- Network diagram: attached (redwood_network_segmentation_v2.png) — highlights VPC boundaries and customer tenant subnets.
- KMS rotation: extracted the rotation schedule and KM policy excerpt; pushing redacted PDF to ShareFile for Cedarline with access controls.

Sarah — I’ll share the Drive link and the ShareFile link once the artifact ACLs are set. If Cedarline prefers a secure SFTP for the artifacts, let me know and I’ll coordinate with infra.

Attachments referenced: runtime_log_sample_202607.zip, redwood_network_segmentation_v2.png

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Engineer, Observability | Redwood Inference
